items.question: Do I need to know code to use MultiVariants?
items.answer: No. Rulesets, restrictions and product options are all set up with forms inside the app. Custom CSS is there if you want it, but it is optional.

items.question: Why isn’t MultiVariants showing on my product page?
items.answer: Check that the app embed is active, the ruleset status is Enable, and the product matches the ruleset’s Applies to condition. If it still doesn’t show, contact support and we’ll check your theme.

items.question: Can I set a minimum order quantity?
items.answer: Yes. Set a minimum or maximum per variant or for the whole product, sell in fixed increments, or offer preset bundle quantities.

items.question: Can I offer quantity discounts?
items.answer: Yes. Create a tiered discount set and connect it to your rulesets, so prices drop as customers buy more.

items.question: Do restrictions work in the cart too?
items.answer: Yes. Apply restrictions to the cart page as well, so customers can’t check out below or above your limits.

items.question: Is there a free plan?
items.answer: Yes. The Starter plan is free. Paid plans add more features and limits.
